title: Family Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary
A leading Kent-based law firm are seeking a Legal Secretary to join their busy Family Team based in Maidstone. This firm are recognised in the Legal 500 and have an excellent reputation across Kent, Sussex and further afield. The successful Family Legal Secretary will be welcomed by a friendly and warm environment, modern offices and lots of fun social events throughout the year.
The successful Family Legal Secretary will be supporting a small team of Solicitors and Legal Executives and will be an important, pivotal part of this exciting group of legal professionals.
This is a busy and fast-paced role that requires good time management, strong administrative skills and great client care skills. It is essential that you have experience of working as a Legal Secretary/Administrator within a Family department, with a good understanding of the demands of this type of role.
The duties of this role include, but are not limited to:
- Support with the administrative aspects of family law - opening and closing files, on boarding clients, diary management, preparing file bundles etc
- Prepare and draft legal documents related to family law
- Liaise with clients, solicitors and other relevant parties to obtain necessary information or documentation.
- Attending client meetings - note taking where appropriate.
- Respond to telephone and email inquiries in a professional manner.
- Maintain and update files and databases.
- Organise and schedule appointments and meetings, as necessary.
- Track key deadlines, ensuring all required actions are promptly undertaken.
- Preparing invoices, tracking payments, and managing financial records.

Requirements:
- Proven experience as a Family Legal Secretary or similar role within Family law.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficient in MS Office and legal software.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Exceptional time management skills.
- Knowledge of the conveyancing process.
- Excellent interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, effectively collaborating with colleagues.

Benefits:
- Opportunity for hybrid working (after 6 months service)
- 23 days holiday + bank holidays + Christmas eve + Birthday
- Pension scheme
- Death in Service (3x Salary)
- Private Medical Insurance (after 12 months service)
- 15% off legal services
- Employee Assistance Programme

Job type: Full-time, permanent
Location: Maidstone, Kent
Salary: 27,000 - 35,000 (depending on experience)
GWV Talent Solutions Limited (trading as Gerrard White Consulting and Vermelo RPO) acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary and contract workers.
